description_en: Retrieves the real-time count of active original and transcoded streams for a specified streaming domain
description_zh: 获取直播流的实时在线原始流和转码流流数信息
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-stream-count --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveStreamCount

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain.

Make sure that the domain name is added to ApsaraVideo Live and that you have the permissions to operate on it
parameters.help_zh:
主播流域名。
传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限
parameters.name: domain_name
